correctness.rationale: The neutral expectation update for each active star is the written row-stochastic 3x3 matrix with eigenvalues 1, lambda=1-1/[n(n-1)], mu=(n-2)/[n(n-1)]; tau-th powers are exact spectral-projector combinations. The stationary row of T=M_B^tau M_A^tau is (U,V,(n-2)W)/Z by substitution/tree formula, and coalescence ensures fixation equals limiting expectation. Explicit subtraction yields V-U=(n-1)(n-2)(1-x)(1-y)>0 and W-V=(n-1)(n-2)x(1-y)>0. For tau/n^2->theta, x->exp(-theta), y<=n^(-tau), U~n,W~n^2,Z~n^3 uniformly. Independently built full 2^n state absorbing chain n=3,4,5, tau=1,2 reproduces all three probabilities. No nonneutral or shifted-phase claim.
residual_risks: No nonneutral, arbitrarily phased or unequal-block switching theorem.
